text:
sophie: heads up @maria @omar — ran a focused activation-rebalancing sweep on llama-13b with long-context workloads (128k). unexpected: plain INT8 had a sizeable PPL hit but enabling act-rebalance closes most of it. posting configs and numbers, please skim and flag anything questionable :eyes:

maria: nice. can you paste the exact experiment command and the hyperparams you used?

sophie: sure — command + key flags:
```
python eval_longctx.py 
  --model=llama-13b 
  --context=131072 
  --quant=mix (fp16, int8, awq, fp8) 
  --gptq_chunk=64 
  --act_rebalance=True 
  --act_rebalance_mode=scale_clip 
  --act_scale_init=0.8 
  --kv_caching=True 
  --batch=1 
  --eval_set=longctx_microbench_v2 
  --runs=500
```
notes: act_rebalance=False for baseline INT8 run, AWQ uses our awq-v2 bits, FP8 uses dynamic-e4m3 emulation.

omar: can you drop the summary table?

sophie: results (median across 5 seeds, 500 prompts):
```
model,quant,ppl,mrr10,delta_pct_vs_fp16,tokens_per_sec,gpu_mem_gb
llama-13b,fp16,11.2,0.432,0.0,210,31
llama-13b,int8,13.9,0.401,+24.1%,260,18
llama-13b,int8+act-rebalance,11.8,0.428,+5.4%,250,19
llama-13b,awq,12.0,0.425,+7.1%,245,17
llama-13b,fp8,11.5,0.430,+2.7%,230,20
```
quick take: int8 without act-rebalance shows a clear degradation on long contexts; activation-rebalancing almost fully recovers PPL and MRR while keeping memory savings. FP8 is closest to fp16 but with higher GPU memory than int8. AWQ sits between.

maria: good detail. what's the distribution of the rebalancing scale? any outliers per-layer?

sophie: per-layer scales concentrated in [0.6,1.2], a few outliers in early MLP layers ~1.8. I clipped at 2.0 to avoid instabilities. No huge per-layer variance besides first two MLP blocks.

nate: what's statistical significance? 95% CI on MRR?

sophie: int8 vs fp16 MRR delta is -7.1% (95% CI +/-1.2%). int8+act-rebalance delta is -0.9% (+/-0.9%), so overlap with fp16.

omar: any qualitative failure modes — hallucinations, truncation, worse tool-calling?

sophie: small uptick in token-level repetition for raw int8 at >80k context, resolved with rebalancing. tool-calls (structured json) unaffected at these evals.

maria: can we replicate on a different model family (mosaic or internal-ggml 13b) before recommending rollout?

sophie: scheduled a quick cross-model run tomorrow on rw-dedicated-3. If results mirror, we can add act_rebalance into the default int8 profile for longctx.

deploy-bot: job scheduled: cluster=rw-dedicated-3 job_id=job-2026-06-15-8472 status=queued

omar: sweet. next: run a small canary serving test with A/B routing and golden prompts. i'll open a canary task. :thumbsup:
